entities.name: PMID:9057141
observations: A prospective randomized study compared reamed and unreamed intramedullary interlocked nailing of femoral shaft fractures; in the distal-fracture subgroup, reamed nails had shorter time to union (p<0.05). The result concerns time to union, not a demonstrated higher union rate.

entities.name: Faster union with reaming
observations: In a randomized study of femoral shaft fractures, distal fractures treated with reamed nails had shorter time to union than those treated with unreamed nails (p<0.05); this is not the same as a higher union rate.
